Hi Oliver —

Thanks again for taking time to chat last week. I know your team will be on the UK roadshow the week of Jan 12; you mentioned an on-site demo at the Manchester office would be ideal. We’d love to do a focused 45–60 minute session tailored to your platform team + SREs to walk through:

- Low-latency inference demos (Redwood Dedicated)
- Cost/latency tradeoffs and quantization profiles
- Integration patterns for your current infra (K8s + VPC peering)

Are you still available on Jan 13 or 14 in the afternoon (UK local time)? I’ve attached a draft agenda and your travel itinerary we pulled from the roadshow calendar — happy to adjust.

Proposed slots (UK time):
- Wed Jan 13 — 14:00–15:00
- Thu Jan 14 — 10:00–11:00 or 15:30–16:30

Jordan (AE) will run the demo; Marissa (CSM) will join for the integration discussion and next steps. If none of these work, tell me the best day/time window while you’re in Manchester and we’ll follow your lead.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
